_comment: Per-provider INFERENCE-serving assumptions, verified batch 4 (experiments/co2e/research/batch4/01+02). region_mix weights sum to 1 and are sampled CATEGORICALLY (one region per request). pue is [P5,P50,P95]. hardware_mix over hardware_classes ids; 'sram' providers use sram_speed_premium applied to gpu_blackwell-modeled energy. Optional u_fleet overrides the constants default (independents run less saturated than hyperscalers). tier_multipliers scale total energy. region_variants are customer-selectable (hyperscalers only).
